decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk system builds directly on the firm's office and conference furniture know-how, and flexible workplaces remain in demand, so the firm can read the results and keep refining the line.
A chair family sits at the core of the firm's craftsmanship, upholstery and material expertise, which makes it easy to absorb feedback and improve the models over time.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory that reaches beyond the firm's core furniture knowledge, so dropping them is plausible, but they reuse the rug materials and fit the curated-materials strategy, which tips the decision to keep.
The soft sofa extends the firm's established upholstery and lounge competence and comes from close collaboration with a renowned designer studio, both strong reasons to retain it.
A high standing table is a modest extension of the firm's conference and table expertise and fits agile workplace trends, though as a single model it is somewhat easier to discontinue.

The rug collection is the firm's declared flagship and supports its direction toward natural materials and complete interiors, so management will keep building the required textile knowledge rather than abandon it early.
